categories.name: Commodity-backed Stablecoin
categories.content: A commodity-backed stablecoin is a type of stablecoin designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to a reserve of physical commodities such as gold.

categories.name: Flaunch Ecosystem
categories.content: Flaunch Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via flaunch.gg.

categories.name: OpenServ Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on OpenServ, a multi-chain crowdfunding platform designed for autonomous startups and Agentic Applications (aApps) built on OpenServ’s AI reasoning infrastructure.

categories.name: CNY Stablecoin
categories.content: A CNY stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Chinese Yuan Renminbi.

categories.name: Commodities Meme
categories.content: Meme projects tied to commodities in traditional finance.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Parody Meme
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by the names of well-known brands, individuals, or cultural icons.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Duck-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by duck.

categories.name: Quest-to-Earn
categories.content: Quest-to-Earn refers to a gamified system in which users complete specific tasks or challenges to earn rewards, which can be in the form of points, tokens, or other incentives.

categories.name: Reality Ecosystem
categories.content: Reality is a platform by Bitget that issues tokenized real-world assets (like U.S. stocks and ETFs) backed 1:1 by securities, bringing them on-chain with stablecoin dividend payments.

categories.name: NFT Launchpad
categories.content: Platforms that enable users to deploy and launch their own NFT projects.

categories.name: Echo Launchpad
categories.content: Echo.xyz is a decentralized launchpad that enables early-stage project funding.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: BagsApp Ecosystem
categories.content: BagsApp Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via bags.fm.

categories.name: Education
categories.content: Decentralized educational platform built on blockchain technology.

categories.name: Decentralized Science (DeSci)
categories.content: Decentralized Science aims to leverage the blockchain and Web3 tools to create an open ecosystem to conduct, and disseminate scientific research.
